evidence.note: The preprint reports growth and correlations within flagged visual misinformation. Its platform-specific observational sample does not establish broad attributable acceleration.
The revision predates the cutoff. Greater virality and lower model-annotated harmfulness and believability qualify the picture but do not measure the claimed acceleration.

reviews.rationale: No deadline was supplied, and neither study meets the early-resolution rule. Growth in flagged synthetic content does not establish an attributable acceleration of misinformation across the internet. The packet neither settles nor refutes the forecast.
